text: Analysers: steam and water analysis system (00QUA10) per VGB-S-010 and DEC-EPCE-0015: cation conductivity, specific conductivity, pH, dissolved oxygen, sodium and silica at the sampling points of the cycle chemistry; two independent cation conductivity measurements per condenser water box half (ER-07.10); sample coolers and constant temperature and pressure conditioning; alarms and limits of the chemistry are a design input from the cycle chemistry criteria.
